dedupe_keys.name: trbr vanuatu telecommunications market statistics 2012 to 2018 and annual sector reports

description: The Telecommunications, Radiocommunications and Broadcasting Regulator of Vanuatu publishes telecommunications market statistics on its website, with yearly pages for 2012 to 2015, 2017 and 2018. Each year has pages on the overall market, the mobile retail services market and the internet retail services market, giving subscribers, revenues, traffic, coverage of the population and operator shares for Digicel Vanuatu and Vodafone Vanuatu (formerly TVL). The homepage also promotes a 2025 annual report and a 2025 sector report. Coverage: Vanuatu, national by year. Format and access: HTML pages with tables and charts on the TRBR website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the statistics pages stop at 2018; the 2025 sector report was not located as a file; the pages were not read in detail, so the indicator list is partly inferred. Simulation uses: demand and coverage baselines for a small island network exposed to cyclones such as Pam (2015) and Harold (2020). Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives national series; data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell positions for Vanuatu.
